entities.name: Essi Renvall
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ester ”Essi” Renvall was a Finnish sculptor. She studied in Suomen Taideyhdistyksen piirustuskoulu 1930–1932. Her works were in public exhibition for the first time in 1933.
